notes:
Race Engineer 0.5.0

This release closes the loop between fuel, tyres, pit strategy and race history,
and hardens everything that endurance racing exposed. Recommended for all users.

Highlights

* Race Summary — a new History tab that answers "how was my race?": laps, pace,
  fuel and pit stops, with a stint-by-stint breakdown and a comparison against
  your previous session on the same car and track.
* Tyre recommendations stay on screen — a second always-on-top overlay holds a
  pending tyre-change recommendation for as long as it applies, instead of a
  toast that clears itself while you are looking at the track.
* Honest confidence — when tyre strategy has no recommendation yet, the app now
  tells you how many samples it has against how many it needs, and a new Race
  Readiness line summarises whether fuel, tyres and pit are ready.
* Tyre-only stops are costed correctly — pitting for tyres alone also costs the
  time of pitting at all, which is now included instead of only the marginal
  cost over a fuel stop.

Fixed

* No more unnecessary pit call on the final lap when the fuel already on board
  reaches the checkered flag, and no more pit calls after the flag has fallen.
* "Stay out" and "pit window open" are no longer announced at the same time
  after a stop, with two chat macros sent to iRacing.
* Phantom pit stops are gone. Leaving the garage, a mid-race garage visit and
  the first tick on a parked car were each recorded as real stops and were
  corrupting the pit-loss and tyre-service figures the strategy depends on.
* The live race can no longer be deleted from History. Opening History during a
  long pre-race wait could erase the running session, after which nothing else
  from that race was recorded.
* A session's end time is now recorded when the session actually ends.
* Local yellow flags no longer discard a lap's fuel sample — only a full-course
  caution does. On long circuits this was costing the fuel estimate a large
  share of its samples, and measurably in the wrong direction.
* Tyre wear is no longer displayed as a negative percentage, and a stop with no
  reading is recorded as "not measured" rather than as a measured zero.
* Overlays can no longer get permanently pinned on screen by the positioning
  button.
* Fixed a crash when opening the History window, and a Portuguese tyre
  recommendation shown with an English explanation.

Also in this release

* Fuel level is now recorded at the end of each lap and at pit entry and exit,
  and fuel added at a stop is derived from it.
* Only one copy of Race Engineer runs at a time; a second launch brings the
  existing window forward.
* Fuel-critical alerts are suppressed once you are already on pit road.
* Closing the window is faster.

Known limitations

* Tyre wear per stint is still not recorded for a completed stop — iRacing
  delivers the reading after the car has left the pits. This release reports
  that honestly instead of storing a false zero.
* A recorded session still corresponds to an application run rather than to an
  iRacing practice, qualifying or race session.
